answers.rationale: For partner active weekends, Kara repeatedly rejects doubles and uncertain assigned-at-check-in rooms in favor of a confirmed single queen or king. Since the king is the same price, location, and terms as the queen, the complimentary king upgrade is the best confirmed one-bed option.

A confirmed king is the cleanest one-bed alternative after queens sell out. Kara has specifically accepted a king when a queen was unavailable and has filtered out two-double, waitlist, and unassigned-bed options for couple trips.

For teaching trips, Kara prioritizes a confirmed, reliable one-bed room with the required coffee/fridge setup over doubles, waitlists, or arrival-assigned rooms. The confirmed conference-hotel king also preserves the best event logistics; a switch-to-queen request is appropriate only if availability reopens.

Kara treats queen and king as acceptable single-bed outcomes and has chosen a confirmed king when queen inventory was unavailable. The sponsor-cap room guarantees exactly that acceptable one-large-bed outcome, avoids the two-double fallback, and does not impose the extra cost of the farther queen suite.
